entries.definition: General information (not from your document): The range of work the freelancer is expected to perform under the agreement.
General information (not from your document): A document that details the specific tasks, deliverables, and timelines for the project.
General information (not from your document): An attachment to the agreement that contains additional details, such as the Statement of Work.
General information (not from your document): The date on which the agreement becomes active.
General information (not from your document): The length of time the agreement remains in effect.
General information (not from your document): The automatic extension of the agreement for additional periods unless notice is given.
General information (not from your document): A regular, fixed payment made to the freelancer for ongoing services.
General information (not from your document): A bill submitted by the freelancer requesting payment for services rendered.
General information (not from your document): An obligation to keep certain information secret and not disclose it to others.
General information (not from your document): Legal rights over creations such as designs, writings, or software.
General information (not from your document): The work products that the freelancer must provide to the client.
General information (not from your document): To promise to compensate the other party for certain losses or claims.
General information (not from your document): To agree not to hold the other party liable for certain damages.
General information (not from your document): A method of resolving disputes outside of court, where an arbitrator makes a binding decision.
General information (not from your document): The legal system whose rules will apply to interpret the agreement.
General information (not from your document): Events beyond a party’s control that excuse performance under the contract.
General information (not from your document): A restriction that prevents the freelancer from working for competitors for a set time.
General information (not from your document): To transfer rights or obligations under the agreement to another party.
General information (not from your document): A company or entity that is related to another through common ownership or control.
General information (not from your document): The authority of a particular court to hear a case.
